name: Guerrilla Graphix
old_description: Guerrilla Graphix is a small business located in Albuquerque, New Mexico, in the heart of the Nob Hill district. We offer a diverse selection of over 1,000 gift items available for both retail and wholesale customers. Our prices are competitive, and we provide a variety of services, including graphic design, custom screen printing, embroidery, and large-format digital printing. Stop by and check us out!
about:
Guerrilla Graphix operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico, in the city's Nob Hill district. The small business offers a diverse selection of over 1,000 gift items for retail and wholesale customers, alongside custom printing and design services.

The company provides graphic design, branding, pre-press layout, and logo development, and produces custom screen printing, embroidery, and large-format digital printing on apparel such as T-shirts, hoodies, hats, bandanas, aprons, tote bags, team jerseys, and uniforms. It also runs an online store featuring pop-culture and New Mexico-themed merchandise, and offers wholesale contract printing services for resellers.

Customers include retail shoppers, wholesale buyers, and organizations seeking custom branded apparel. The wholesale program supplies giftware and apparel to resellers, while the contract printing side serves teams, businesses, and local groups needing uniforms or promotional items.

Guerrilla Graphix emphasizes original, often humorous or topical designs that "catch the eye, push the envelope, and pull the leg," spanning artistic, political, historical, and regional themes. Competitive pricing and in-house production are noted as part of its approach.
